text: Inflation. Groceries cost twice what they did a few years ago.
Unemployment. People can't find decent jobs around here.
Climate change and all the extreme weather.
The border. Nobody is controlling who comes in.
Drugs, fentanyl coming into every town.
Homelessness in the cities is out of control.
The politicians in Washington. They fight and nothing gets done.
Health care costs too much, even with insurance.
I don't know, there are so many.
